patch_description:
The validation failure was caused by the original implementation corrupting row placement and column identity during recursive processing. In particular, `column_recursion` wrote completed futures back using enumeration order rather than the source row index, `original_index` was added and later used as a data column, recursive DataFrame reconstruction discarded labels/types, and the method returned an empty column-ordering list despite changing row contents. The implementation also optimized cell-level statistics rather than the serialized character-prefix objective.

This replacement preserves every original row, value, shape, index, and column label. It constructs a small bounded set of column-order candidates, scores each candidate using the exact sorted serialized-row LCP objective, selects the best one, lexicographically orders the resulting strings, and returns valid per-row column orderings. It avoids modifying cells for scoring and handles missing and mixed values through a separate serialization representation.
